neighbours.label: The number (digits or a spelled-out number) opening the SECOND of two matching number-unit hyphen compounds in English, after an earlier one set the pattern, as in 'a 2-lane road and a 6-lane road' or 'a forty-seat bus, then a ninety-seat bus'; it peaks on the number just before the hyphen. Quiet: a lone compound with no earlier match ('a 4-door car'), plain counts ('6 lanes'), score lines and ranges ('3-1', 'pages 10-14'), word compounds ('low-cost'), non-English text and code strings.
fire: They widened the 2-lane road into a 6-lane road last summer.
We rented a forty-seat bus for the trip, then a ninety-seat bus for the return.
She swam the 50-meter race in the morning and the 200-meter race after lunch.
The recipe calls for a 9-inch pan, but a 10-inch pan works too.
He owns a 3-bedroom house in town and a 5-bedroom house by the lake.
After the three-hour flight came a seven-hour layover.
My old phone had a 12-megapixel camera; the new one has a 48-megapixel camera.
The 4-door sedan sold out, so we bought a 2-door coupe.
quiet: They widened the old road into one with 6 lanes last summer.
We rented a forty-seat bus for the trip and drove home in cars.
She swam two races, one in the morning and one after lunch.
The recipe calls for a 9-inch pan.
He owns a house in town with 3 bedrooms and a cabin by the lake.
The flight lasted three hours and the layover lasted seven.
neighbours.short: number opening the 2nd of two matching number-unit hyphen compounds
